question: Are people happy with the pictures they get from the Google Pixel 4a?
answer:
One reviewer said the Pixel 4a shoots great pictures with nice colors and good dynamic range, and that they were really happy with how the pictures turned out. [994cdda37a2b_7]
That same reviewer said the contrast is at a good level and the pictures look amazing for a $350 device. [994cdda37a2b_7]
One reviewer called the Pixel 4a fantastic and especially praised the camera. [a7f49359bf3c_0]
One reviewer described the Pixel 4a as having a strong camera system and said they were happy with the phone. [2f3785300b23_0]
One reviewer said the Pixel 4a takes great pictures and highly recommended it for someone wanting a small yet powerful phone. [401545047fac_2]

chunks.text: It can shoot 4K videos at 30fps or 1080p video at 60 fps. The front facing camera has an 8 MP sensor, an f/2.0 aperture and an 88 degrees field of view. The 4a shoots great pictures with nice colors and good dynamic ranges. The contrast is at a good level as well. Overall the pictures look amazing for a $350 device. I have attached some images that show the same picture shot with the Google Pixel 4a, the iPhone X and the iPhone XR. I am really happy with how the pictures from the 4a turned out. The Pixel 4a of this article is rocking the Android 10, June 2020 build. As all Google Android phones, it has a simple but very smooth and to the point GUI.
Pixel 4a is terrific. I had the Pixel3 and it was ok but in 4a they have improved everything. Fantastic phone and especially the camera.

First Impressions- Not Quite as impressed. OK so i am coming from a Nexus 5X which had started to creak and so i needed a new phone and was really happy to see all the positive reviews for Pixel 4a& the fact that it is small was a major plus for me , i just got and it and in many ways it is great , the plastic actually feels premium and the screen is great .
Been a week since I bought the pixel 4a.. The phone has the nicest feel to it. I'm so glad I bought it through here beaming face with smiling eyes smiling face with smiling eyes .
As good as I expected!. 2020’s Pixel 4a is still good in 2022 for light use and with strong camera system, I’m happy with this phone!
Great. I really love my Google pixel 4a phone

And you also get 3 year software update guarantee. So if you are not looking for a premium phone, but something small yet powerful and takes great pictures, then Pixel 4a is an excellent choice! Highly recommended!
